title: Animating A* Search Snapshots with Matplotlib FuncAnimation
description: Define animate_search and its per-frame callback frame(k) to update an AxesImage im and current-node scatter marker across all snapshots in RES["snapshots"].
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Import `animation` from `matplotlib` and start `animate_search`: build the base image array `base`, create the `AxesImage` `im = plt.imshow(base, ..., animated=True)`, and initialize scatter artists `scat_start`, `scat_goal`, and `scat_cur`.

Define `frame(k)` to unpack `open_k, closed_k, cur = snapshots[k]`, copy `base` into `img`, and shade `closed_k` and `open_k` with their supplied intensities. Draw `path` with its supplied intensity on the final frame. Update `im.set_array(img)` and `scat_cur.set_offsets([[cj, ci]])`.
`animation.FuncAnimation` calls `frame(k)` for `k` from `0` through the final snapshot index. It updates `im` and `scat_cur` in place rather than creating a new figure each frame.

steps.question: On which frame index `k` does `frame(k)` overlay the final `path` intensities onto `img`?
steps.answer: Only on the very last frame, when `k` is the final snapshot index (line 22).
